name: reading-log
description: Personal reading stopwatch: start and stop from the phone, the Mac (Raycast), Siri or Alexa, and see how much you read.

scripts.dev: node scripts/init-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply reading_log --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply reading_log --remote && wrangler deploy
